title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval, pursuant to G.L. c. 164 § 94 and 220 CMR 5.03, a Firm Transporation Agreement with Osram Sylvania.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. The Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC03-17)
